cases.source: I do not eat meat or fish.
cases.query: 给我推荐晚餐前，需要记住什么饮食限制？

cases.source: My sister is getting married in Lisbon in December.
cases.query: Where and when is the family wedding taking place?

cases.source: 猫毛会让我打喷嚏，所以家里不能养猫。
cases.query: Which pet causes my allergy?

cases.source: My bicycle was stolen outside the library last Tuesday.
cases.query: 我的两轮交通工具是在哪里丢的？

cases.source: 我每周四晚上去游泳馆练自由泳。
cases.query: When do I practise swimming?

cases.source: I am learning Portuguese because I plan to move to Porto.
cases.query: 我为什么在学葡萄牙语？

cases.source: 我的护照放在书桌最下面的抽屉里。
cases.query: Where did I put my travel document?

cases.source: I prefer written instructions because phone calls make me anxious.
cases.query: 我更希望别人用什么方式给我说明？

cases.source: 我在十月十五日开始新的工作，第一天要早上九点到。
cases.query: What is the starting date and arrival time for my new job?

cases.source: My favourite way to relax is tending the tomatoes on my balcony.
cases.query: 我通常做什么来放松心情？

cases.source: 我的笔记本电脑一插电，风扇就会很吵。
cases.query: ¿Por qué hace ruido mi ordenador al cargar?

cases.source: I promised my grandfather that I would visit him every Sunday.
cases.query: 我答应过爷爷多久去看他一次？

cases.source: 我不喜欢别人突然来家里，来之前请先发消息。
cases.query: What boundary did I set about unexpected visitors?

cases.source: I am saving money to buy a second-hand piano.
cases.query: 我存钱是为了买什么乐器？

cases.source: 我们把周六的野餐改到周日，因为天气预报说周六下雨。
cases.query: Why did we move the picnic to a different day?

cases.source: My presentation is next Wednesday and I want to rehearse the night before.
cases.query: 我打算什么时候练习演讲？

cases.source: 我的钥匙串上挂着一个蓝色的小鲸鱼。
cases.query: ¿Cómo puedo reconocer mi llavero?

cases.source: I stopped drinking coffee after lunch because it keeps me awake at night.
cases.query: 为什么我下午不喝咖啡了？

cases.source: 我更喜欢别人直接指出错误，不要绕着说。
cases.query: How would I like people to give me corrective feedback?

cases.source: The emergency spare glasses are in the red box beside my bed.
cases.query: ¿Dónde guardo las gafas de repuesto?
